title: Retort leak testing, methanol dosing and acceptance checks for a muffle atmosphere mesh-belt furnace
summary: Retort leak testing and methanol dosing do not directly establish oxidation-free or decarburisation-free treatment. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s muffle mesh-belt furnace proposal dated 17 November 2024 combines a heat-resistant steel retort, supporting-plate/belt transport and methanol atmosphere supply in an oil-quenching/tempering line. Separate retort sealing, atmosphere supply and workpiece-quality verification when comparing equipment.
